review.notes:
ReFineID is a driver and signing app for the Finnish national identity card (FINEID). It requires physical hardware the review team is unlikely to have: a FINEID smart card and a USB CCID smart-card reader. On iPhone the card can also be read over NFC.

Without the card, the app launches to its status window and shows "Present your identity card to the reader". That is the intended no-hardware state, not an error. A short video of the full flow on real hardware can be provided on request.

The bundled CryptoTokenKit token extension is the card driver; it makes the card's certificates available system-wide (Safari, Mail), which is the product's purpose. No accounts, no login, no data collection. Privacy policy: https://www.refineid.fi/privacy-policy/

en-US.subtitle: Your ID card, in Safari
en-US.promotionalText: Log in to services with your Finnish identity card.

description.macos:
ReFineID brings the Finnish identity card to the Mac.

Insert your identity card into a USB smart-card reader and sign in to e-services directly in Safari with the certificate on your card. Drop a PDF on ReFineID to sign it with a qualified signature, carrying a qualified timestamp and the evidence for long-term validation.

ReFineID is open source: github.com/ReFineID/ReFineID-Apple
description.ios:
ReFineID brings the Finnish identity card to iPhone and iPad.

Read your card with a USB-C smart-card reader, or on iPhone with the built-in NFC antenna, then sign in to e-services directly in Safari with the certificate on your card.

ReFineID is open source: github.com/ReFineID/ReFineID-Apple

description.macos:
ReFineID tuo suomalaisen henkilökortin Maciin.

Aseta henkilökortti USB-kortinlukijaan ja kirjaudu sähköisiin palveluihin suoraan Safarissa kortin varmenteella. Pudota PDF ReFineID:hen ja allekirjoita se hyväksytyllä sähköisellä allekirjoituksella, jossa on hyväksytty aikaleima ja pitkäaikaisvalidoinnin todisteet.

ReFineID on avointa lähdekoodia: github.com/ReFineID/ReFineID-Apple

ReFineID tar det finländska identitetskortet till Macen.

Sätt identitetskortet i en USB-kortläsare och logga in på e-tjänster direkt i Safari med kortets certifikat. Släpp en PDF på ReFineID för att underteckna den med en kvalificerad elektronisk underskrift, med kvalificerad tidsstämpel och underlag för långtidsvalidering.

ReFineID är öppen källkod: github.com/ReFineID/ReFineID-Apple
